whatItBuilds.description: What this workflow set out to build, in plain language, for a colleague who was not in the room. Name the thing produced and who it is for. No status here.

whatHappened.description: What actually happened, with the verdict in the FIRST sentence. Name the kind of thing every status word refers to — a run node-graph state, a criterion, a gate verdict, a human's delivery decision are four different things and must never be blurred into one 'passed'.

trueOutcome.description: What the reader actually got, stated at full strength. Every caveat, unproven criterion and failure survives here at its original weight; softening one is falsification. If the state document does not say, write 'not recorded'.

nextSteps.description: What to do next, ordered by consequence. 'Nothing — this is finished' is a valid answer when the state supports it. Never invent an action the state gives no grounds for.

numbersUsed.description: Every number that appears anywhere in the four parts above, each copied EXACTLY as the state document wrote it. The platform re-checks each one against the state; a number that is not there is flagged to the reader as unverified.
